title: The Hall of Pillars
brief: Hoo! You made it to the end of the Reading Road! Build a Hall of Pillars for the 7 Pillars of Virtue, then take a photo for your teacher.
look: This stop is a great hall. Each pillar stands for good character, like the people we met in our books this year.

models.name: Castle - Pillar 1
models.why: the first pillar of your hall

models.name: Book - Courage
models.why: courage: acting even when you are afraid

steps.title: Know your models
steps.text: These are your five models. Say each name out loud. This list is also in VR, in the **Canvas** tab.

steps.title: Build it
steps.text: Press the **top button on your right controller** and click **Models**. Put the **pillars** in a row. Put one **book** at the foot of each pillar.

steps.title: Say it out loud
steps.frame: “This pillar is ___. A character who showed it this year is ___.”
steps.text: Stand by one pillar and say this out loud:
steps.spoken: Stand by one pillar and say this out loud. This pillar is… A character who showed it this year is…

steps.title: Snap and submit
steps.fits: your pillars and the three books

extra.text: Add a **Book - Joy**. Say the most joyful part of your reading year.

points: Your photo shows a row of pillars with a book at each one.

mapday.intro: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read what each character did and tap the pillar it shows. Then finish two sentences about your year.
mapday.miss: Not that one. Look at the 7 pillars again and think.
mapday.done: ✓ You matched every pillar. Now finish the two sentences.
